output.text: Our shared workspace balances collaboration and privacy. The shared tray holds frequently used stationery, accessible to all. Drawing materials are placed on the window side for natural light and inspiration. A clear center remains unobstructed, enabling smooth exchange of large sheets. Each person has a private corner for focused work. This layout supports daily routines, respects personal space, and encourages teamwork. The shared tray, window side, and clear center are essential to our functional, considerate design.
